heading: Case Studies
aside: Six narrated walkthroughs. Synthetic data throughout.

items.title: Rivulet LocalOps
items.line: One synthetic request through ten written checks: where it is, whose jurisdiction it falls in, what the policy allows, and who signed it off.
items.alt: A map view showing a reported point in Glenorchy and the council it was referred to

items.title: LifeOps Atlas
items.line: What the system checked and what it refused to guess, ending on the numbers from the side-by-side trial rather than on a claim.
items.alt: A summary screen: 43 days of trial, 418 past records reconciled, 288 of 295 automated tests passed

items.title: AgriSentry
items.line: A farm AI that watches, explains in plain words, and still waits for a person before anything is sprayed.
items.alt: The farm risk dashboard answering a question about which blocks need attention today

items.title: AI-Native Payment & Agent Engineering Lab
items.line: An investigation into a payment agent that passed everything it was asked to pass, and what that still did not prove.
items.alt: A still from the film: the reconciliation pipeline with a disputed payment held for review

items.title: Cyber Finance City
items.line: A walk through the UE5 city, where the questions the characters ask come from a retrieval service rather than from the level.
items.alt: A still from the film: the neon city scene used for the financial-education experience

items.title: Little Red: Sequel
items.line: A solo Unreal Engine game whose pixel-style art came off a Stable Diffusion pipeline rather than being drawn one asset at a time.
items.alt: A still from the film: the dark-fantasy hub of the game
